name: Ride Joburg 97
heroCopy: Build a clear 97 km pacing plan for the all-new Ride Joburg route with checkpoint arrival times and segment speed guidance.
notice: New for 2026 — an all-new route with a new start and finish at Kyalami. Old splits don't apply. Build a fresh plan.
elevationNote: Profile derived from route GPS data — confirm against official race information before race day.

checkpoints.name: WP1 Fourways
checkpoints.note: Fast start off Kyalami with an early descent. Ride calm, don't chase wheels.

checkpoints.name: WP2 Randburg
checkpoints.note: The Douglasdale drag starts around km 11 — long and steady. Find your rhythm.

checkpoints.name: WP3 Zoo Lake
checkpoints.note: Jan Smuts rises through Bordeaux and Parkwood. Eat before the KOM.

checkpoints.name: WP4 City South
checkpoints.note: Over the Westcliff KOM, through town and across Nelson Mandela Bridge. Recover on the high ground.

checkpoints.name: WP5 Soccer City
checkpoints.note: Halfway at 48.5 km. Rolling, exposed roads out west — share the work if there's wind.

checkpoints.name: WP6 Parktown
checkpoints.note: The Nasrec rises drag you back up to the Parktown ridge. Steady effort, no surges.

checkpoints.name: WP7 Sandton
checkpoints.note: Over the top and descending through Sandton. Free speed in a group — stay alert.

checkpoints.name: WP8 Woodmead
checkpoints.note: Rolling descent continues. Eat now — the last climb is coming.

checkpoints.name: Finish Kyalami
checkpoints.note: The Woodmead sting bites around km 90 (~4 km at 2%). Crest it, then empty the tank to Kyalami.
